personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces
personality_one_liner: A premium, Apple-inspired personal finance tracker that uses minimal geometry, soft glassmorphism, and precise typography to make money management feel effortless and modern.

spacing.rule: Generous Apple-like padding. Minimum 16px horizontal margins. Cards must breathe.

do's: Use on the hero total balance card on Home dashboard.
Use on the bottom tab bar.
Use on the 'Add Transaction' bottom sheet.
Apply a white tint (Light mode) or dark tint (Dark mode) under the blur to guarantee readability.
dont's: Do not use on regular list items or standard category grid cards.
Do not stack multiple glass cards inside each other.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Introduce value proposition with large minimal illustrations and smooth sliding.
screens.layout: Full screen layout. Top 60% contains the image with a subtle gradient scrim. Bottom 40% contains title, subtitle, dot indicators, and sticky primary button at the bottom.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry via email or guest mode.
screens.layout: Centered form inside KeyboardAvoidingView. Minimal logo at top. Large clean inputs. Primary CTA for Login, secondary text link for Guest mode.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Dashboard overview showing balance, quick actions, and recent activity.
screens.layout: ScrollView. Top header with user greeting. Hero Glass Card containing Total Balance, Income, Expense, and animated ring. Below: horizontally scrolling Quick Actions row. Below: 2-column Category grid. Bottom: Recent transactions list.

screens.name: AddTransaction
screens.purpose: Bottom sheet to rapidly add income/expense without leaving context.
screens.layout: Bottom Sheet. Visible drag handle. Top large numeric input for Amount. Horizontally scrolling chips for Category and Payment Method. Emotion selector row. Sticky 'Save' button.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Visual breakdown of spending via charts.
screens.layout: Segmented control at top (Weekly/Monthly). Large Chart area. Below chart: list of top spending categories.

screens.name: SavingsGoals
screens.purpose: Track progress towards user-defined financial targets.

states.empty: Piggy bank empty state illustration + Add Goal CTA

screens.layout: Vertical list of cards. Each card has a title, target amount, current amount, and a small circular progress ring using brandSecondary (Cyan).

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: User settings, theme toggle, and export data.
screens.layout: Top section: Avatar + Name. Below: grouped settings rows (Appearance, Currency, Export) with leading icon, title, and trailing control (switch/chevron).

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality but inject '6 Glass / Luxe' elements specifically on the Home Hero Card, Tab Bar, and Add Transaction bottom sheet.
Do NOT use pure Material design heavy shadows. Use soft shadows (tier 1) and generous padding (radius lg).
Use Plus Jakarta Sans globally. Do not mix font families.
Ensure the hero circular progress ring and the savings goals rings use smooth react-native-reanimated animations.

For the Add Transaction bottom sheet, ensure the layout is optimized for thumb-reachability: large Amount input at top, horizontally scrolling chips for categories and payment methods, and a sticky bottom CTA.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure empty states use the provided Unsplash images.
